note: The World Inequality Database (WID.world, bulk download of 15 October 2026, read again in that of 30 October 2026), Guinea, 2024: average net personal wealth (ahweal992j) and average post-tax national income (adiinc992j) per adult over 20, resources split equally within couples, in GNF of that year, for the bottom 20, 40, 60, 90 and 99 percent and the top 1 percent; each family's band is read from them. Read 2026-10-30. Read again 2026-11-03 from the bulk download of 30 October 2026 (its country files dated 30 October 2026): every row quoted here, its year and its currency label stood as before, and no later year was given. Until 2026-11-03 this note and its sources wrote the variable codes with their age and population parts swapped (ahwealj992 for ahweal992j and adiincj992 for adiinc992j), codes no file of the database holds (its README: type, concept, age group, population, as in sptinc992j), and called adiinc992j post-tax disposable income, which its metadata names post-tax national income ([Post-tax national income]=[Post-tax disposable income]+[Public spending]). The national accounts (the owner's ruling of 2026-11-03: each band's income scaled by households' disposable income over national income), read 2026-11-03: the latest households' account published for this country was in UNdata's National Accounts Official Country Data (the United Nations Statistics Division's), Table 4.6 and Table 4.1, series 200, SNA 1993, for 2016: the gross disposable income (B.6g) of households (S.14), 55,599,566,371,770, over gross national income (B.5g) 65,437,752,585,188, in the table's currency (Guinean franc), about 0.850. A ratio stands only from 2019 on (the lead's ruling of 2026-11-03), so it wasn't held, and each band's income stayed the database's post-tax national income, public spending included. The national accounts (the owner's ruling of 2026-11-03: each band's income scaled by households' disposable income over national income), searched again on 2026-11-03 in the statistics office's own accounts for a households' disposable income account from 2019 on, found none: INS Guinée (stat-guinee.org, Publications annuelles > Comptes nationaux), read 2026-11-03: 'Comptes nationaux définitif 2021, provisoire 2022' (45 pages) and 'Note d'analyse des comptes nationaux définitifs et rapides 2018-2024' give GDP by production and expenditure only; no integrated economic accounts or households disposable income for 2019 on. UNdata's 2016 account in this note was the latest. Each band's income stayed the database's post-tax national income, public spending included.
